source_metadata.title: Inoculum-Based Dosing: A Novel Concept for Combining Time with Concentration-Dependent Antibiotics to Optimize Clinical and Microbiological Outcomes in Severe Gram Negative Sepsis
source_metadata.input_file: Inoculum based dosing A novel concept for combining Time with Concentration dependent antibiotics to optimize clinical and microbiological outcomes in severe gram-negative sepsis Tilanus A, Drusano G Antibiotics 2023 12 1.pdf

extraction_limitations: The source is a narrative review, not a primary empirical study. The @ATOM schema is designed for primary-literature assertions; therefore atoms describing cited studies represent what this review reports about those studies, not verified extraction from the underlying primary publications.

The article proposes mechanistic and dosing hypotheses. Hypotheses and practice proposals are preserved as author conclusions, limitations, or other atoms and must not be interpreted as established clinical recommendations.
No attempt was made to reconstruct unreported confidence intervals, p-values, denominators, MIC distributions, or patient-level details from cited studies.
QuantitativeResult objects were used only when the review supplied a numeric point estimate plus enough population/exposure/outcome context to satisfy the current Pydantic sufficiency rules.
All atoms are marked needs_review because extraction was performed by a language model without human verification against each cited underlying study.
